subject: Social Media
title: Hiring Algorithms Gone Wrong
description: A 60-second lesson on Hiring Algorithms Gone Wrong.

hook.text: Amazon built an AI recruiter. It penalized resumes with the word 'women's'—as in 'women's chess club.'

buildup.text: It trained on ten years of hiring data—mostly male hires. The AI learned to prefer men.

discovery.text: Amazon scrapped it. But hundreds of companies still use similar tools with unknown biases inside.

twist.text: Removing gender doesn't fix it. Zip codes correlate with race. Schools correlate with class.

climax.text: The EU's AI Act now requires hiring algorithms to pass mandatory bias audits before deployment.

quiz.question: Why did Amazon's AI recruiter penalize women?
options: Training data reflected historical male hiring bias
